parts.title: Snowed In
parts.text: Anya, Theo, and Bashir were at Grandma’s cabin in the mountains. The sky turned gray, and the weather grew **stormy**. Snow fell all day and all night. In the morning, a tall **snowdrift** covered the front door. The children could not go outside.

parts.title: A Cold Morning
parts.text: Bashir looked out the window. The glass was **frosty**, and a long **icicle** hung from the roof. The wind began to **howl** around the cabin. “Put on your **muffler** and your **woolly** socks,” said Grandma. Theo wrapped the warm scarf around his neck.

parts.title: A Warm Corner
parts.text: Grandpa lit a fire in the **fireplace**. Smoke rose up the **chimney**. The children sat on the rug by the **hearth**, where the stones were warm. Grandma made hot **cocoa** with a pinch of cinnamon. The cabin was **sheltered** by tall pine trees, so they felt safe and cozy.

parts.title: Cozy Night
parts.text: That night, the storm finally stopped. The children played a board game and told funny stories. They did not mind being stuck inside. Staying together by the fire was the best part of the whole trip.
